findings.title: --val-pair-chunk must reach every _deform_errors call (identity and frozen baselines too)
findings.fix: Make _deform_errors default chunk=None -> int(self.cfg.val_pair_chunk) so the composed, identity and frozen-baseline calls all honour it; the memory script passes chunk=16 explicitly; add one assertion that the baselines use val_pair_chunk=4.

findings.title: Pin the index b in controls[t].update(b) and note that recalibration consumes training-stream state
findings.fix: State b = global plan index 0..K-1; fit restarts at update(0), which is safe because control values are a pure function of the step; K > 0 consumes K source batches and postprocess draws, so the data order differs from K = 0 (reproducible on resume through checkpointed generators).

findings.title: Test 6 bitwise equality across two different graphs may be fragile
findings.fix: Run with TF_CUDNN_USE_AUTOTUNE=0 and _OpDeterminism; document a 1e-6 relative fallback tolerance if a mismatch can't be traced to skip ops; keep the no-cascade_skip-ops graph check as the strict proof.

findings.title: Decide resume vs fresh once, before building the FrozenStage
findings.where: design.md section 9 vs main.py (trainer.checkpoint.latest_last decided after the Trainer exists)
findings.fix: cascade_resume = bool(args.resume) and C.peek_last_step(<run>/ckpt/last) > 0, computed before any model is built; use it for the FrozenStage factory and the recal gate; assert restore_last() is True when cascade_resume; document that --resume false on an existing run dir is a fresh run that appends a second bn_recalibration event.
